input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision (the only occurrence of "insurance" is in the Net Revenues definition). Commerce One is not a pure software licensor: under Section 5 it provides an on-site full-time operations consultant, implementation and professional services and support, and it operates the MarketSite.net Service through which data of Corio and its Customers is handled. Under the playbook, such a vendor should carry CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request. We therefore insert a short insurance covenant in the Miscellaneous section immediately after Section 14.9 (adjacent to the indemnity in Section 8), with existing 14.10 renumbered. Fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M is available if resisted; severity is low given the licensing-led nature of the deal.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes, stores or has access to data of Corio or its Customers, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant (existing 14.10 to be renumbered), since Commerce One supplies on-site consultants and professional services and its service handles data of Corio and its Customers. Our position is CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M; we can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in Miscellaneous
